functional.definition: F(gamma,u)=Tr[h0 gamma]+beta^-1 Tr[gamma log gamma+(I-gamma)log(I-gamma)]+1/2(d-d0)^T U(d-d0)-sum_a u_a Tr[B_a gamma]+1/2 sum_ab u_a u_b Tr[W_ab gamma]+1/2 u^T Kion u; d_s=Tr[D_s gamma].
functional.domain: Finite ordinary orthonormal pseudo-space analogue, 0<gamma<I, block-collinear spin, beta>0; independent u=(u1,u2). Fixed mean Tr gamma=N0; separately optional fixed Tr[Z gamma]=M0. B_a and W_ab are Hermitian including offdiagonal/nonlocal matrix elements; W_ab=W_ba. U real symmetric with cross-spin term, stationary reference gamma0=FD(h0). Arbitrary dimensionless units, no material parameter claim.
functional.static_oracle: Independently minimize the full functional with number/spin multipliers and differentiate minimized scalar free energy at registered halving steps; compare analytic constrained linear response and explicit W expectation. No fitted counterterm.
